absatz1: I'm Thomas, a Creative Director Brand based in Hamburg with over 15 years of experience in communication design — spanning classic advertising, corporate identity, and strategic brand building.
absatz2: Since 2023 I lead the brand design unit at KONKAV (K16 GmbH), where I've helped shape the identities of companies like Bühler Group, Deutsche Messe AG, collana IT and Sedlmayr AG — from brand strategy and workshops all the way to launch-ready assets. Before that, I spent eight years as (Senior) Art Director at K16 GmbH, working on campaigns and design systems for clients like Dräger, Merck, Schaeffler AG, Telekom AG and T-Systems.
absatz3: I graduated top of my class in Communication Design from Kunstschule Wandsbek Hamburg, and over the years my work has been recognised with six industry awards — including four Deutscher Agenturpreise and a Swiss Excellence Award.
absatz4: What drives me is finding the visual language that makes a brand unmistakeable — whether that's a one-brand strategy for 11 merged companies, a full identity for a Fintech start-up, or a motion campaign shown at scale. I love working closely with teams and clients, and I'm at my best when complex problems need clear, beautiful answers.
abschluss: Let's get in touch — I'm always up for a good conversation about brands, ideas and what we could build together.
